summary: This guide covers optimal summon strategies for players on new accounts, focusing on Option Summons and banner priorities. Players should prioritize saving 300 summons for Child of Chaos before touching Option Summons. Option Summons should only be pulled when holding a full 300 pity guarantee, otherwise players should wait for Option Summons 2. The guide highlights budget and endgame team compositions across Iceblast, Necrosis, Toxin, and Burn elements while emphasizing resource distribution for multi-team content like Continental Challenge.

meta_changes: Continental Challenge (Imperial Shadow Recast) requires preparing up to 6 unique teams without overlapping heroes by week 3, shifting priority toward roster depth over single-team investment.
tips: Never pull on Option Summons banners without 300 summons ready to guarantee your selected hero; wait for Option Summons 2 if short.
Save the First Blush banner until the end of the season to select heroes that fill specific roster gaps.
When pulling duplicate banner heroes, apply them as Inspiration first and only convert to Exclusive Artifacts before the banner expires, as Inspiration can be refunded.
Exclusive Artifacts generally yield better PvE performance than Inspiration level 1 due to recharge mechanics.
